title: The $65 Billion Lie That Fooled Wall Street #shorts
description:
For decades, Bernie Madoff paid investors steady returns. The money was never there. The biggest Ponzi scheme in history, and the sons who turned him in.
Follow for more true stories of fortunes made and lost.
hook_text:
THE $65 BILLION
LIE WALL STREET BELIEVED
first_comment: Would you have invested with him if every friend of yours already had? 👇

lines.text: For decades, he paid his investors like clockwork.
About ten percent a year. In good markets and bad.
His name was Bernie Madoff, a Wall Street legend.
Banks, charities and celebrities begged to get in.
He never invested their money. Not really.
He paid old investors with the deposits of new ones.
Then two thousand eight hit, and everyone wanted their money back.
Clients asked for seven billion dollars. He didn't have it.
He told his sons it was all one big lie, and they called the authorities.
The accounts showed sixty-five billion dollars. The real amount was close to nothing.
He got one hundred and fifty years in prison.
